body: Ake Larry i believe its in orange? Tiny little Italian fusion restaurant the owner is the chef. No frills but the food is top notch and looks beautiful too. Only like 3 tables so good weekdays or get to go.

author: ocphantomphreak
body: It's in Anaheim on La Palma and Blue Gum. This place has awesome food and baked goods. The only problem is that it's across the street from a public disposal and recycling center, it STINKS outside. That said the empanadas are amazing and all the bread is made in house.
